identity_evidence.historical_fit: Held was Minister-President of Bavaria from 1924 to 1933 and remained alive in 1936; the archival circa-1933 portrait is face-visible and period-matching.
identity_evidence.role_fit: Exact Bavarian civic/state-leader identity for the BAY state-council role; civilian suit and hat are source-visible and intentionally retained.
identity_evidence.era_fit: 1933 source is close to the 1936 scenario start and shows period civilian clothing.
identity_evidence.crop_note: Exact source crop only; no resampling, retouching, recolouring, or watermark removal. The NAC band lies below the selected crop and is not present in the identity input.

imagegen_edit.finish_constraints: Identity-preserving HOI4 painted edit only; deliberate opaque brush planes and quiet painted background; no generated replacement person, reconstruction, generic face, second person, invented details, or photo/sepia/filter finish.

ownership_scan.disposition: No active vanilla or current Chaos Redux character/portrait owner for Heinrich Held was found; the Event 006 target is a generated package character whose displayed name is the sourced identity. No transfer guard is needed because no origin character exists.

uncertainty: Commons CC0 dedication is recorded for the upload; archive-side reuse terms should still be independently reviewed before runtime promotion.
ImageGen output preserves a recognizable likeness and painted finish but remains a candidate awaiting independent visual approval.
